n2e935b57c0.headline: Longer-term impact on T&T uncertain
n2e935b57c0.summary: The Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago said the longer-term impact of US-imposed tariffs on the country remains uncertain. It depends on a range of evolving factors.
n2e935b57c0.why: US tariffs affect the export revenues of small open economies, and central bank assessments shape expectations for growth, inflation and the currency.

nd8fb1c4a38.headline: Portugal holds its third general election in 3 years but the vote might not restore stability
nd8fb1c4a38.summary: Portuguese voters returned to the polls for a third general election in three years. The AP reports the vote might not restore stability.
nd8fb1c4a38.why: Political instability can affect government policy, fiscal plans and investor confidence in Portuguese assets.

n380096d45b.headline: Delhi, Maharashtra account for over half of pan-India power consumption by EVs
n380096d45b.summary: An analysis of power consumption by electric vehicle charging stations in India shows Delhi and Maharashtra leading the way. The two states together account for over half of pan-India EV power use.
n380096d45b.why: Electric vehicle charging demand shapes electricity consumption and investment in grid and charging infrastructure.

n09066451cd.headline: Israel's economy grew 3.4% in Q1 as war against Hamas weighs
n09066451cd.summary: Israel's economy grew 3.4% in the first three months of 2025, according to the Central Bureau of Statistics. The war against Hamas in Gaza continued to weigh on growth.
n09066451cd.why: Israel's GDP growth and wartime spending shape the outlook for its shekel, bonds and equities. Quarterly growth data guides central-bank and fiscal policy.

n72f9cfcec6.headline: Jet2 boss fears cost of holidays to popular destination could rise
n72f9cfcec6.summary: Jet2 chief executive Steve Heapy said he is worried that the rise of tourist taxes could push up the cost of holidays to a popular destination. The comments were reported by the Nottingham Post.
n72f9cfcec6.why: Jet2 is a UK leisure airline and tour operator, and tourist taxes affect demand and pricing across package holidays and travel.

nb082d3ce97.headline: No breakthrough expected in EU-Australia trade talks
nb082d3ce97.summary: The Australian prime minister downplayed chances of reviving the stalled EU-Australia trade deal ahead of a meeting. No breakthrough is expected in the talks.
nb082d3ce97.why: Trade agreements set tariff and market-access rules for exports between the European Union and Australia, affecting agriculture and industrial trade.

n896f470381.headline: Occidental Petroleum Corporation (OXY) Joins Hands with ADNOC to Develop Texas Direct Air Capture Hub
n896f470381.summary: Occidental Petroleum has formed an agreement with UAE's ADNOC to develop a direct air capture facility in South Texas. The project is a carbon removal hub in the United States.
n896f470381.why: Occidental is a large US oil and gas producer, and its carbon capture projects are part of its strategy to manage emissions and generate low-carbon revenue.

impacts.name: Occidental Petroleum
impacts.why: Partnering on a carbon capture hub shares development costs and expands its low-carbon project portfolio.

ne2a1b31548.headline: Kissan Card: Punjab Farmers can now Apply for Loans Up to Rs3Lac in new boost
ne2a1b31548.summary: The Punjab Chief Minister announced that the Kissan Card loan limit for farmers has been increased to Rs3 lakh to support agriculture.
ne2a1b31548.why: Farm credit programmes affect rural incomes, input purchases and agricultural output in Pakistan's largest province by population.

n43ce622c51.headline: Centrist wins Romania's tense presidential race over hard-right nationalist
n43ce622c51.summary: A centrist candidate won Romania's tense presidential race against a hard-right nationalist. A huge turnout played a key role in an election many viewed as a choice between East and West.
n43ce622c51.why: Romania is an EU and NATO member, and its political direction shapes investor views on eastern European policy stability and fiscal outlook.

n88662d09d5.headline: 'Crazy increases': Surging butter prices slice into bakery's margins
n88662d09d5.summary: Surging butter prices are cutting into a New Zealand bakery's margins, according to the NZ Herald. Stats NZ figures show food prices have increased by 3.5%.
n88662d09d5.why: Food price inflation feeds into New Zealand's consumer price index and influences Reserve Bank of New Zealand decisions on interest rates.

ne05b736899.headline: UK’s largest natural gas storage facility to shut down without government help
ne05b736899.summary: Centrica said it remains in talks with ministers about government cooperation to expand and revamp its Rough storage facility. Without that help, the UK's largest gas storage site is set to shut down.
ne05b736899.why: Centrica is a British energy company that operates the Rough gas storage site, which is important for securing UK winter gas supply.

n58c8145c66.headline: EOG Resources, Inc. (EOG) Awarded Oil Exploration Concession for UAE Shale Block
n58c8145c66.summary: EOG Resources has won a new onshore oil exploration concession in the United Arab Emirates, according to a report on its latest development.
n58c8145c66.why: EOG Resources is a large US crude oil and natural gas producer, and new acreage can add to its long-term production pipeline.

na66e2a27a3.headline: Search for signs of Trump trade slowdown as RBA meets
na66e2a27a3.summary: Uncertainty over Donald Trump's tariffs and their economic impact could spur the Reserve Bank of Australia to act, according to the report. Investors are watching the RBA meeting for signs of a trade-driven slowdown.
na66e2a27a3.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which shapes borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and domestic growth expectations.

n23c507f1e6.headline: Renewables, AI rules top productivity reform wishlist
n23c507f1e6.summary: Australia's Productivity Commission has identified fifteen areas for reform, including artificial intelligence, tax reform and cheaper energy. The list forms a reform wishlist for policymakers.
n23c507f1e6.why: The Productivity Commission is Australia's independent federal advisory body on economic policy and productivity reform.

n450664e706.headline: 'Worst it's been': How cafes are adjusting to soaring butter prices
n450664e706.summary: Cafe operators say butter prices are at their worst, and they have not yet passed the cost on to consumers.
n450664e706.why: Dairy prices affect food input costs and retail pricing, and New Zealand is a major global dairy exporter.

n80ee0a34c8.headline: Why are house prices collapsing after Government has rolled out red carpet to speculators and landlord loop holes?
n80ee0a34c8.summary: House prices in New Zealand fell 1.1% in the year to April, according to REINZ. The article attributes the decline to speculator and landlord policy settings.
n80ee0a34c8.why: Residential property is a major component of household wealth and bank lending in New Zealand. Price trends shape mortgage credit and consumer spending.

n565b0b3b4b.headline: FPIs pump Rs 18,620 cr in equities in May on global tailwinds, improving domestic fundamentals - OrissaPOST
n565b0b3b4b.summary: Foreign investors have invested Rs 18,620 crore in Indian equities so far in May, following a net investment of Rs 4,223 crore in April, the first inflow in three months.
n565b0b3b4b.why: Foreign portfolio investment flows are a key gauge of global investor sentiment toward India's equity market and can affect the rupee and market liquidity.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n4e1a1d667a.headline: M&S and Co-Op: BBC reporter on talking to the hackers
n4e1a1d667a.summary: BBC News reporter Joe Tidy spoke directly to those who claim responsibility for hacking Marks & Spencer and the Co-op.
n4e1a1d667a.why: Marks & Spencer is a major UK retailer, and cyberattacks on large retailers can disrupt trading and raise operational and reputational costs.

na0551a603a.headline: The UK is open for business again - Taipei Times
na0551a603a.summary: The UK government says it struck a landmark free trade agreement with India, the fastest growing G20 economy. The article presents the deal as a vote of confidence in the UK economy.
na0551a603a.why: Free trade agreements lower tariffs and barriers, which can expand export opportunities for UK and Indian companies.

n386f4fe85c.headline: Exporters rattled as India shuts land ports to key Bangladeshi goods
n386f4fe85c.summary: India has closed land ports to key Bangladeshi goods, and analysts describe the move as harsher than US trade tariffs on China. Exporters are reported to be rattled.
n386f4fe85c.why: Land ports carry much of the informal and bilateral trade between India and Bangladesh, so closures can disrupt garment, food and raw-material supply chains that multinational buyers rely on.

n07c1478e95.headline: East German leader demands more federal aid as data shows some uptick
n07c1478e95.summary: The state premier of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern asked Chancellor Friedrich Merz's new government to take decisive action to revive the sluggish economy, even as some data shows an uptick.
n07c1478e95.why: Germany's federal government controls much of the fiscal support for its states, and German economic growth is a key driver of euro-area performance.

n8d4777d75f.headline: ‘Define mixed development’
n8d4777d75f.summary: Consumers and stakeholders have called for the proposed Real Property Development Act to clearly define mixed development, which currently lacks legal protection.
n8d4777d75f.why: Property development rules shape buyer protections and project risk for developers and listed property companies in Malaysia.

nc221bdbc5c.headline: Trump tells Walmart to 'eat the tariffs'
nc221bdbc5c.summary: President Trump reacted angrily to Walmart's warning that his tariffs will force the retailer to raise prices, telling it to 'eat the tariffs'.
nc221bdbc5c.why: Walmart is the largest US retailer, so its pricing and margins are sensitive to import tariffs.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: Walmart's warning that tariffs will raise prices puts its margins and pricing strategy in focus.

n03b596f088.headline: Half of China's heavy truck sales could be EVs by 2028, CATL says
n03b596f088.summary: CATL's chairman said half of China's heavy truck sales could be electric vehicles by 2028, up from 10% in 2024. The comments were reported in a media report on Sunday.
n03b596f088.why: CATL is the world's largest EV battery maker, so electrification trends in trucking directly affect its demand.

n195b3a395c.headline: PSX sees historic rebound after ceasefire, IMF tranche approval
n195b3a395c.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange staged a historic rebound after a ceasefire and approval of an IMF tranche. Analysts expect the KSE-100 index to reach 165,215 points by December.
n195b3a395c.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark index, and IMF funding is a key indicator of the country's external financing and economic stability.
n195b3a395c.why_moved: The rebound followed a ceasefire and the approval of an IMF tranche, which reduce economic and financing risk for Pakistan.

n4efa7c8db7.headline: Trump urges Walmart to absorb tariff costs amid rising consumer prices
n4efa7c8db7.summary: President Donald Trump said on social media that Walmart should absorb the added costs created by his tariffs, as consumer prices rise.
n4efa7c8db7.why: Walmart is the largest US retailer, so its pricing and margin decisions are a bellwether for consumer prices and the pass-through of tariffs. Retail margins are sensitive to trade policy.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: A public demand that Walmart absorb tariff costs could pressure its margins or pricing decisions.

nd993575e76.headline: Trump’s tariffs may mean Walmart shoppers pay more, his treasury chief acknowledges
nd993575e76.summary: Walmart executives said higher prices began appearing on shelves in late April and accelerated this month. The Treasury secretary acknowledged that tariffs may mean shoppers pay more.
nd993575e76.why: Walmart is the largest US retailer, so its pricing signals how tariffs pass through to consumers. Retail margins and inflation data are closely watched by investors.

n8b7a057c11.headline: Chip sector to rise more than 19% - Taipei Times
n8b7a057c11.summary: Taiwan's semiconductor output is expected to rise more than 19% this year, the Industrial Technology Research Institute said. Gains are driven by integrated circuit manufacturing and design segments.
n8b7a057c11.why: Taiwan is home to TSMC and a major share of global chip production, making its semiconductor output a key indicator for the global tech supply chain. Chip demand affects many technology and industrial companies.

n12d242b371.headline: Bessent warns tariffs will return to ‘Liberation Day’ rates if negotiations aren’t in good faith
n12d242b371.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that tariffs on trading partners could return to the Liberation Day rates if they do not negotiate in good faith. The comments came on Sunday.
n12d242b371.why: US tariff policy directly affects import costs, trade flows and corporate margins for companies across global supply chains.
n12d242b371.why_moved: The Treasury Secretary's warning that tariffs could return to earlier higher rates raises uncertainty over trade policy for partners and exporters.

n2af5cb6a8e.headline: China slaps anti-dumping duties on plastic imports - Taipei Times
n2af5cb6a8e.summary: China announced anti-dumping duties as high as 74.9% on engineering plastic POM copolymers from Taiwan, the US, the EU and Japan. The Ministry of Commerce concluded a probe launched in May last year.
n2af5cb6a8e.why: Anti-dumping duties raise the cost of imported inputs and can shift sourcing toward domestic or third-country suppliers. Chemical producers in exporting countries are typically affected.
